note: EVERY threshold in this file is PROVISIONAL. They were set by reading the national distribution of database_time minus collection_time, not validated against ground truth. The organisers have not confirmed the timezone of either time field.
difference_definition: database_time minus collection_time, in seconds, per retained observation (reporting_lag_seconds is NULL in gps_clean.parquet while the timezone is unconfirmed, so the difference is computed from the two timestamps)

local.note: device-day median difference near 0 or a small positive reporting lag

offset_5h.note: device-day median within this distance of expected_offset_seconds AND consistent (below)

consistency.note: a non-local offset only counts as a clock offset when at least this share of the device-day's observations lie within window_seconds of the device-day median. A median drifting up through hours with a wide spread is delayed or buffered upload, not a clock offset.

device.note: a device has a stable class when at least min_measured_days device-days were measured (class local/offset_5h/other) and at least min_share_same_class of them agree. Device-days that are unknown (too few observations or inconsistent difference) inherit a stable device class; otherwise they stay unknown.

exclude_note: Devices classed unknown or other stay in every table but their journeys are not used to form regular services (override with --clock-exclude).
